C12 has superficially similar incorporation language for an attached list, but that is routine amendment language and does not provide a material template for the child's design provisions.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Color and Flag of the Vice President of the United States shall consist of a white rectangular background","parent_excerpt":"the flag of the United States shall hereafter be displayed at Fort McHenry National Monument and Historic Shrine","explanation":"C06 also contains an operative rule concerning a flag, but it addresses when and where an existing flag is displayed rather than prescribing a new flag's design."},{"child_excerpt":"The Color and Flag of the Vice President of the United States","parent_excerpt":"do hereby direct that the flag of the United States be displayed on all Government buildings","explanation":"C02 shares only the broad subject of a flag and contains no parallel heraldic specifications or administrative machinery."},{"child_excerpt":"the illustrations and specifications which accompany this order and which are hereby made a part thereof","parent_excerpt":"List A attached to and made a part of the said Executive order","explanation":"C12 uses similar incorporation-by-reference phrasing, but this is routine drafting language applied to an amendment list and is not a concrete, material template for the child's order."}]}
